ROOT.lessons: 1. Full greedy (try all remaining txns) dramatically beats 10-sample greedy even from one starting point (WL1: 265->228 in 2s). 2. Multi-restart full greedy finds diverse local minima (WL1 best: 203 from 48+ restarts). 3. Insertion moves combined with swaps are essential for WL1 LS to reach 178 (vs 183 with swaps only). 4. ILS (perturb+LS) dramatically improves WL2 (55->36-39) and WL3 (50->37-38). 5. WL2/WL3 LS converges in ~3s per ILS iteration; using tight iter_time_limit=5s gives 3x more ILS iterations than the 15s default, enabling deeper exploration. 6. Adaptive strategy (detect avg_ops/txn) correctly routes WL1 to greedy-heavy path and WL2/WL3 to ILS-heavy path. 7. WL2/WL3 results are stochastic: best seen is WL2=36 (B3), WL3=37, but not simultaneously achievable reliably.
